n6466f448e2.headline: Uganda says Islamic Development Bank approves R12.28bn loan
n6466f448e2.summary: The Islamic Development Bank's board approved a €650.7 million loan to Uganda. The financing will help fund the standard gauge railway project.
n6466f448e2.why: The Islamic Development Bank is a multilateral development lender in Jeddah. Large infrastructure loans shape public borrowing and construction activity in recipient countries.

nb096f07569.headline: Israeli strikes kill at least 20 in Lebanon hours after ceasefire
nb096f07569.summary: Israeli strikes in Lebanon killed at least 20 people on Saturday, according to Lebanon's state news agency NNA. The strikes came one day after a ceasefire with Hezbollah took effect.
nb096f07569.why: Renewed fighting in Lebanon raises regional geopolitical risk, which can affect oil prices and risk assets across the Middle East.

ne64c4efc74.headline: Africa's Bank Backs Uganda's Arua Airport in a €156M Bet
ne64c4efc74.summary: The African Development Bank has approved €156 million to upgrade Arua Airport in Uganda. The project is intended to improve border links and boost regional trade.
ne64c4efc74.why: The African Development Bank is a multilateral lender that finances infrastructure across Africa, and its projects shape regional trade and investment flows.

n6063a25cc9.headline: Trump threatens Iran as Vance leads peace talks in Switzerland
n6063a25cc9.summary: The US and Iran agreed to a 60-day ceasefire for negotiations, but the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps declared the Strait of Hormuz shut on Saturday. Vance leads the talks in Switzerland.
n6063a25cc9.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for global oil shipments, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices, shipping costs and energy-sensitive sectors.
n6063a25cc9.why_moved: The IRGC's declaration that the Strait of Hormuz is shut, despite a 60-day ceasefire for negotiations, raises the risk of disruption to oil shipments through the waterway.

nec3e9138c0.headline: Kenya Lines Up a $750M World Bank Loan, Tied to Reform
nec3e9138c0.summary: The World Bank's board votes on June 26 on a $750 million loan for Kenya. The budget financing is tied to reforms in public finance, markets and climate.
nec3e9138c0.why: World Bank loans provide concessional budget financing to developing economies, and their conditions shape fiscal and regulatory policy for investors.

n75511e3968.headline: Tsipras' ELAS Pushes Luxury Tax in Greece
n75511e3968.summary: ELAS, Alexis Tsipras' new party, advocates taxing ultra-luxury lifestyles and dividends. The aim is to boost state revenue and address inequality.
n75511e3968.why: Tax policy changes in Greece affect fiscal revenue, investor returns on dividends and the country's political risk profile.

n65d49ebc69.headline: Gold, silver rates outlook: Bullion investors to track US-Iran talks, crude oil trends and key global data next week
n65d49ebc69.summary: Gold and silver prices are expected to be driven by US-Iran negotiations, crude oil moves and a packed global macro calendar in the coming week. Analysts spoke to PTI.
n65d49ebc69.why: Gold and silver are traditional stores of value and are sensitive to geopolitical risk, interest rates and the dollar. Their prices are set on global futures markets such as COMEX.

n60bcd490c9.headline: Oil and milk prices to spill the tea on inflation story
n60bcd490c9.summary: The Australian Bureau of Statistics will this week release inflation and employment figures for May. Oil and milk prices are expected to shape the inflation story.
n60bcd490c9.why: The ABS compiles Australia's official inflation and labour statistics, which guide Reserve Bank of Australia rate decisions. These figures move Australian bond yields and the Australian dollar.

nc169f19b64.headline: ADB to maintain private sector funding pace in India, eyes $1 billion support in 2026
nc169f19b64.summary: India remains the largest market for the Asian Development Bank's private sector operations. The lender expects to provide about $1 billion in direct financing this year.
nc169f19b64.why: The Asian Development Bank is a multilateral lender whose financing supports infrastructure and private projects in Asia.

nd800f67dc5.headline: Relief for Pakistani Elites as Govt slashes Hi-Octane Levy by Rs214/Litre
nd800f67dc5.summary: The federal government sharply reduced the petroleum levy on high-octane fuel by Rs214.12 per litre. The move lowers the cost burden on fuel buyers.
nd800f67dc5.why: Petroleum levies are taxes on fuel that change domestic pump prices and government revenue, affecting inflation in Pakistan.

nb7021a4882.headline: More fuel relief for motorists with halfway measure
nb7021a4882.summary: Motorists will receive an extended fuel discount, but the savings will be lower as the government weighs its options, according to the report.
nb7021a4882.why: Fuel excise and discount policies affect transport costs, consumer spending and petrol price inflation in Australia.

n1a331f5385.headline: Aluminum’s war shock blunted by dark transits and Chinese supply
n1a331f5385.summary: The Iran war triggered one of the biggest shocks to global aluminium markets, with prices surging above $4,000 a tonne. A strong supply response from the Middle East, China and Indonesia helped prevent a full-blown crisis.
n1a331f5385.why: Aluminium is an industrial metal used in construction, autos and packaging, and it is sensitive to Middle East smelter output and energy costs.

n5fd9147631.headline: Imported Mobile Phones could get Cheaper in Pakistan as FBR mulls Tax Cut
n5fd9147631.summary: Imported smartphones have become more expensive in Pakistan due to heavy taxes. The Federal Board of Revenue is considering a tax cut that could bring relief to importers and users.
n5fd9147631.why: The Federal Board of Revenue sets Pakistan's tax policy on imports, which affects consumer prices and trade flows.

n52b21a4cb3.headline: Australian economy 'drifting' despite natural gifts
n52b21a4cb3.summary: Weak productivity growth and stifling business conditions are preventing Australia from capitalising on its economic strengths, according to a think tank.
n52b21a4cb3.why: Productivity growth determines long-run living standards and potential GDP growth, which shape investment and rate expectations.

na2e7aff82b.headline: All our human developers could be replaced by AI within a few years years - SAP boss
na2e7aff82b.summary: The chief executive of SAP said human software development may soon cease entirely inside the company. He suggested AI could replace all of the firm's human developers within a few years.
na2e7aff82b.why: SAP is a major German enterprise software company, and its AI strategy affects the future cost structure and labour needs of the software industry.

na1ce10e5e6.headline: The U.S. and Iran agree to a 'road map' for a final deal, mediators say
na1ce10e5e6.summary: Qatar and Pakistan said US and Iranian negotiators made encouraging progress in Switzerland despite a rocky start. Trump had threatened to hit Iran very hard again during the talks.
na1ce10e5e6.why: Negotiations between Washington and Tehran shape sanctions, oil supply risk and broader Middle East stability for global markets.

nbb60627c10.headline: RVNL Wins ₹2,977 Crore NMDC Contract, Major Vizag Infrastructure Project To Boost Order Book
nbb60627c10.summary: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited has secured a Rs 2,977 crore contract from NMDC to build a 10 MTPA buffer stockpile and blending yard in Vizag over 42 months.
nbb60627c10.why: Rail Vikas Nigam is an Indian state-run railway infrastructure company, and large contract wins add to its order book and revenue visibility.

n7a417a7a9d.headline: Texmaco Rail Wins Odisha Power Orders, ₹11.65 Crore Transmission Projects To Be Completed In 12 Months
n7a417a7a9d.summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured two orders worth Rs 11.65 crore from Odisha Power Transmission Corporation. The turnkey transmission line projects are to be completed within 12 months.
n7a417a7a9d.why: Texmaco Rail & Engineering is an Indian rail wagon and engineering company whose order inflows indicate its infrastructure business growth.

nf68c66d6ae.headline: Depositors await clarity on leverage
nf68c66d6ae.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's overhaul of FCNR(B) deposit rules has drawn strong interest from non-resident investors. Banks and high-net-worth individuals are waiting for clarity on leveraged structures.
nf68c66d6ae.why: FCNR(B) deposits are foreign-currency accounts held by Indian banks for non-resident Indians, and rule changes affect bank funding and rupee-linked flows.

n3cbacbcf47.headline: Xiaomi's first full-size SUV: Sky Nomad N90 spotted in China, 500+km EREV with built-in tent
n3cbacbcf47.summary: Xiaomi's first full-size SUV, the Sky Nomad N90, has been spotted in China with over 500 km EREV range and a built-in tent. Pricing may start at 200,000 yuan, with an official reveal expected in Q4 2026.
n3cbacbcf47.why: Xiaomi is a Chinese consumer electronics maker that has expanded into electric vehicles, making its car launches relevant to the competitive EV market.

n0b05293675.headline: More fuel relief for motorists with halfway measure
n0b05293675.summary: Motorists will receive an extended fuel discount, but the savings will be lower as the government weighs its options. The measure is a halfway step on fuel relief.
n0b05293675.why: Government fuel subsidies and discounts affect consumer spending, inflation and the fiscal cost of energy policy.

n83519e64d2.headline: Twelve containers arrived at a Thai port labeled as scrap metal, and what inspectors found inside is forcing the US to take back something it hoped no one would notice
n83519e64d2.summary: Thailand seized 284 tonnes of US electronic waste falsely labelled as scrap metal at Laem Chabang port, a discovery described as shaking up the global waste trade.
n83519e64d2.why: Laem Chabang is Thailand's major deep-sea container port, and cross-border waste shipments are regulated under international trade rules.

nb6f422f614.headline: BABA Stock: The Physical AI Race Heats Up as Alibaba Releases New AI Models for Robots
nb6f422f614.summary: Alibaba is launching new robot-focused AI models and strengthening its position in the physical AI market. The move extends its AI push into robotics.
nb6f422f614.why: Alibaba is a major Chinese e-commerce and cloud group, and its AI investments affect its growth outlook.

n24450197e1.headline: US, Iran begin talks as Lebanon conflict jeopardizes deal - Taipei Times
n24450197e1.summary: The US and Iran held talks in Switzerland after signing a preliminary agreement to end their war. The Lebanon conflict threatens to derail the deal, which is meant to trigger a 60-day period.
n24450197e1.why: Middle East conflict and the security of regional oil and shipping routes feed directly into global energy prices and risk sentiment. Negotiations between Washington and Tehran are closely watched by investors for that reason.
n24450197e1.why_moved: The talks are tied to a preliminary agreement to end the war, while the Lebanon conflict is described as a threat to that deal.

ncbdea4fecf.headline: Lam Research (LRCX) Is Up 6.1% After AI-Fueled Beat And Raised Chip-Equipment Outlook
ncbdea4fecf.summary: Lam Research reported quarterly revenue growth of 24% year over year and earnings above guidance. It raised its outlook for wafer fabrication equipment demand, citing strong AI-driven orders.
ncbdea4fecf.why: Lam Research makes semiconductor manufacturing equipment, so its orders signal capital spending by chipmakers. Its results are a read-through for the AI-driven chip investment cycle.

impacts.name: Lam Research
impacts.why: Earnings beat and raised outlook for wafer fabrication equipment demand drove the share gain.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

ncbdea4fecf.why_moved: Quarterly revenue rose 24% year over year, earnings beat guidance, and the company raised its outlook on AI-driven equipment demand.

n1eacaa0df9.headline: Property transactions hit nine-year low last year - Taipei Times
n1eacaa0df9.summary: Property transactions in Taiwan hit a nine-year low last year. The source report gives limited further detail in the available text.
n1eacaa0df9.why: Property transaction volumes indicate housing demand and the health of real estate lending. Weak activity can weigh on construction, banks and household spending.

n5632f794c8.headline: ‘Dutch disease’ not a problem: central bank - Taipei Times
n5632f794c8.summary: Taiwan's central bank said that 'Dutch disease' is not a problem for the economy. The source text provides no further detail in the available description.
n5632f794c8.why: Dutch disease describes how a surge in one export sector can strengthen the currency and hurt other industries. Central bank views shape expectations for currency and monetary policy.

n6782f9588d.headline: Investments to China decrease further - Taipei Times
n6782f9588d.summary: Taiwan's investments to China decreased further, according to a Taipei Times report. Details were not included in the source description.
n6782f9588d.why: Taiwanese capital flows into China reflect cross-strait economic ties and affect supply-chain and trade exposure for Taiwanese firms.
